decision.summary: Tom gave one month's notice to leave 10 Nov. Under the Renters' Rights Act tenants need two months' written notice, so the earliest end is 10 Dec 2026 unless the landlord agrees in writing to sooner. I replied to Tom, asked Ben for a decision on an earlier date and set a follow-up.

answers.question: Is the notice valid as given? What is the earliest end date under current law?
answers.answer: No, one month is too short; two months' written notice is needed. Served 10 Oct 2026, earliest end is 10 Dec 2026.

answers.question: What options exist to end sooner?
answers.answer: Only the landlord agreeing in writing to a shorter notice/earlier end date (e.g. 10 Nov); the tenant could also find a replacement only if landlord agrees. Otherwise rent is due until 10 Dec.

answers.question: What do you reply and what do you start?
answers.answer: Replied to Tom explaining the two-month rule, that sooner needs landlord written agreement, and that keys/deposit will follow once the date is settled. Asked Ben for a decision (APR-102) and scheduled a chase for 15 Oct (FUP-103).

conflicts: Tenant says one month's notice / leave 10 Nov; current law requires two months. Legal position preferred.
assumptions: Notice treated as served on receipt, 10 Oct 2026 by email
Tenancy is assured periodic per CRM; no landlord agreement to shorter notice on file

args.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for letting us know, and congratulations on the new job. 

Since 1 May 2026 a tenant needs to give two months' written notice, so one month's notice on its own doesn't end the tenancy on 10 November. Counting from your email today (10 October), the earliest end date would be 10 December 2026. Rent stays payable until the tenancy ends.

You may be able to leave sooner if your landlord agrees in writing to an earlier date. I'm asking him now whether he will agree to 10 November and will come back to you as soon as I hear, and no later than Friday 16 October. Please don't treat 10 November as agreed until you have that in writing.

On keys and your deposit: I'll confirm the key return arrangements once the end date is settled. Your deposit is protected with mydeposits and is dealt with after you move out, once the flat has been checked. I can't give you a date or amount yet.

Kind regards,
Mare & Co Lettings
